defect: The published definition quantified over arbitrary chain complexes but called the direct sum over p+q=n a finite-diagonal sum; for two unbounded complexes that diagonal can have infinitely many nonzero summands.
correction_basis: The standard direct-sum totalization is well-defined on arbitrary chain complexes. The repair removes only the false finiteness assertion, preserves the direct-sum formula and Koszul differential, and lets the bounded-above consumer derive diagonal finiteness from its own hypotheses.
